messages:
Maya L: Quick follow-up from Friday's outage. We need a concrete testing + eval plan so these failures don't recur. Goal: owners, minimal timelines, and clear acceptance criteria.
Diego C: I'll take ownership of the regression suite expansion. Plan is: take incident traces -> extract failing prompts -> create a focused adversarial bucket (~120 prompts) + 300-sample augmentation from similar templates. ETA: initial draft by Mon EOD.
Erin S: I'll own the nightly A/B load job and the telemetry guards. Proposed job: 90m at 150 rps against staging-A and staging-B, with a 10m 3x spike in the middle. We'll add token-rate and p95 latency alerts. Need a separate isolated pool to avoid cross-contamination.
Ben T: I'll coordinate the chaos drill. We should simulate a KV-GC pause (the root cause pattern looked like KV GC stalling), and a simulated model-worker OOM followed by slow restart. Suggest Wed 02:00 UTC in a dedicated test window.
Maya L: Good. Can we also add a targeted eval for the tokenization edge case? That was subtle and may not surface in normal prompts.
Diego C: Yep. I'll add a tokenization edge bucket (derived from the logs) and write a small deterministic eval harness: exact-match + normalized-levenshtein thresholds.
qa-bot: Created ticket TEST-8112 "Postmortem: tests & chaos plan (regression/load/kv-gc)" and added assignees Maya L, Diego C, Erin S, Ben T. Link: https://redwood.internal/TEST-8112
Erin S: Acceptance criteria proposal: regression = no >1.5% drop in primary eval F1; tokenization eval = <0.5% increase in tokenization-error rate; load job = no retries >0.2% and p95 < 180ms; chaos drill = graceful degrade only (no lasting cache corruption). If any criteria fail, runbook triggers a bug-blocker label and postmortem annex.
Ben T: For the chaos drill rollback, ops playbook will include: kv-gc abort, restore from snapshot, and worker-swap command. I'll paste the commands here when ready.
Maya L: Team deadlines: Diego (regression + tokenization eval) draft Mon EOD, Erin (load + telemetry) infra PR by Tue midday, Ben (chaos plan + rollback) runbook draft Tue EOD, Maya will own the consolidated comms for customers and the follow-up board.
Diego C: Small note on decoding variants: run regression with prod decoding + one alternative (top-p=0.92) to catch sampling-sensitive diffs.
Erin S: Adding a quick CI job snippet for the nightly load runner. Will put in staging-ci.yaml:
```
jobs:
  nightly-load:
    schedule: "0 4 * * *"
    runs-on: runner-staging
    steps:
      - run: ./infra/load-test --target staging-A,staging-B --duration 90m --rps 150 --spike 3x --telemetry token-rate,p95
```
Ben T: Also recommend a short chaos checklist (5 items) to keep drill small and observable. I'll author it.
Maya L: Product asked for a short customer-friendly summary after tests. I'll draft but need final results by Thu EOD. If any of you expect delays, flag them in TEST-8112.
infra-bot: Linked TEST-8112 to infra-ops board and scheduled a 1h sync for Tue 17:00 UTC as requested by Maya L.
Diego C: I'll also add a small script to replay exact request sequences from the incident logs so we can repro locally.
Erin S: Telemetry guard detail: if token-rate jumps > 30% over baseline for >2m, CI will fail the job and create a regression alert. Adding that as a hard stop.
Maya L: Thanks all. Owners recap posted to TEST-8112. I'll close the loop here after the first run and tag PM for the customer note. :white_check_mark:
